impact_policydoc: Directive 2010/75/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council
justification: The European Climate Law sets a framework for reducing greenhouse gas emissions, which can reinforce the implementation of the Industrial Emissions Directive, as it sets emission standards for industrial installations, including those in the energy and transport sectors.

impact_policydoc: On the quality of water intended for human consumption
justification: The recast of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive can enable the implementation of the Water Framework Directive, which aims to improve the quality of water bodies, by reducing pollution from urban wastewater.

impact_policydoc: Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan
justification: The amendment of the ETS Directive can aid the implementation of the Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan, as it sets a framework for reducing emissions from energy and transport sectors, which are critical for achieving a healthy planet.

impact_policydoc: European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials
justification: The amendment of the Regulation on the inclusion of aviation in the EU ETS can facilitate the implementation of the European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials, as it promotes the use of sustainable and safe chemicals.

impact_policydoc: On reporting of environmental data from industrial installations and establishing an Industrial Emissions Portal
justification: The amendment of the Regulation on land use, land-use change and forestry can reinforce the implementation of the Regulation on reporting of environmental data from industrial installations, as it sets a framework for reducing emissions from land-use sectors.

source_policydoc: On an EU Strategy to reduce methane emissions
impact_policydoc: on ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe
justification: The EU Strategy to reduce methane emissions can aid the implementation of the Directive on ambient air quality, as methane is a potent greenhouse gas that contributes to air pollution.

impact_policydoc: Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan
justification: The Renovation Wave initiative can facilitate the implementation of the Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan, as it promotes energy-efficient buildings and reduces energy consumption, which is critical for achieving a healthy planet.
